install.title: Install
install.html:
Install with the skills CLI, which works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other agents:

npx skills add caldoai/skills

To install a single skill:

npx skills add caldoai/skills --skill untangle-codebase

Or, in Claude Code, add this repo as a plugin marketplace:

/plugin marketplace add caldoai/skills

Then install a skill with the command in its row of the table below.

To install by hand instead, copy a skill's folder into ~/.claude/skills/.
